introduction: 《一蕊金花》拍攝了台灣第一代流行女歌手鶯鶯的故事與生活，它帶領我們了解黑膠唱片的時代、流行小曲的時代——那是台灣人開始創作自己的歌謠的日子。《一蕊金花》可以看到一代一代的台灣人，如何建構這塊土地的文化、社會等價值認同。導演王明霞說，在拍攝這部紀錄片時，也得到很多珍貴的口述歷史，從陳金花家族的訪談，也能夠看到他們所經歷的時代記憶。At the ripe age of 102, Chinhua Ho Chen, “Miss Golden Blossom”, takes center stage. In 1938, her voice graced the tracks of “Endless Spring” and “The Camellia Lady”, released by Victory Records, under the stage name “Yingying”. She also stands as the first among renowned female singers of Taiwan’s popular ditties. Through Miss Chinhua, we hear the echoes of the once renowned singer Yingying, preserving the distinct voices of Taiwan in popular music and songs.
